Call log:

    at /__w/luojiaxinshi/luojiaxinshi/scripts/verify_notice_matters.mjs:34:470

case_accounting.failed_case_without_completed_check_reco: library groups related notices and can switch back to individual records

verified_control_flow: The timeout is the last wait on line34, after the second group-toggle click; its predicate only contains tag. The first full-title group wait, first toggle and both individual a/b card waits returned before this point.

createLibraryUI writes grouped only at its initial declaration, owner change initialization and one synchronous delegated group-button click. Search results, stable reload and ordinary clock updates do not reset that variable.
notices/page attaches notice_matters annotations to nonempty returned rows. Clock-only merge preserves matter because matter is outside its dynamic-field whitelist.
The two toggle clicks and output waits are present, but the fixture did not record aria-pressed, actual event targets, request/response order or filtered response IDs.
possible_experiments_not_yet_run: Actual createLibraryUI plus actual PagedList in a controlled DOM: load grouped data, dispatch query input and two delegated group-button clicks, independently release delayed exact-query page and stable-refresh responses. Assert button state, distinct individual rows and grouped output. This isolates response ordering without asserting it caused the original WebKit failure.
Isolated real API merge then exact-query notices/page: require both records to retain the same matter metadata. This isolates backend persistence/search, not the browser hit target.
not_established: Which request or DOM state existed at the failed second click.
Whether the click reached the intended live button or whether matching grouped data was absent at that instant.
A unique product or fixture root cause. The 12000ms timeout itself is not evidence that it needs a longer timeout.
record.conclusion: The failure remains unresolved. Do not infer final-main success from PR66 or other passing suites.
